name: Malaria, Leishmaniasis, Trypanosomiasis, Toxoplasmosis and Babesiosis

reference.source: Paniker's Textbook of Medical Parasitology 8th Ed + Ananthanarayan and Paniker's Textbook of Microbiology (topic maps; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Sequestration in cerebral capillaries comas while hypnozoites sleep in hepatocytes; LD bodies parasitise reticuloendothelium fibrosing spleen, and trypanosomes cross blood brain barrier once CSF pleocytoses.
additionalDifferentials: Falciparum versus vivax by rings, dots and relapse
Kala azar versus CML by LD bodies and rK39
Toxo versus lymphoma rings by thallium and PCR
additionalInvestigations: Thick thin smears with RDT and G6PD before primaquine
rK39 with marrow or splenic LD bodies
CSF staging in sleeping sickness with brain imaging in rings
